name: a create map restamps the prediction to the server born and stamps, and later writes of its registers tick after them
a join map rewrites the called id in queued deltas, refs, guards, command args and predictions, and refuses a queued delete of it
a replayed start maps to its run without from; only the life and born move
an end map restamps the predicted endedAt and leaves other registers alone
a later guard naming the predicted stamp follows the map to the server stamp, and its write ticks after it
a map restamps a queued write of a register it names with a fresh tick of the instance that receives the result, in its actor, though another instance committed the write
an entry a join map lengthens past a request alone is refused too-large at numbering, with its notice, and never sent
